query: Use cassandra-table-creation-profile to prepare a non-executing four-table smoke plan with zero writes, a five-second hold, phase validation, and artifact checks.

Use cassandra-table-creation-profile to validate an existing run and derive only the requested allocation and wall Java Flight Recorder views.
